causalSequence: toss potatoes, pumpkin, carrots, onion in oil; season
spread garlic butter under breast skin; stuff cavity with lemon, garlic; tie legs
sit chicken on/among veg in one roasting tray
roast 60-100 min until thigh juices run clear, basting once
make GF gravy from pan juices, cornflour, stock; or serve pan juices as-is
steam greens; carve chicken, serve with veg and gravy
techniqueFacts: par-cooking potatoes 10 min before roasting speeds crisping (1 source)
garlic-herb butter under the breast skin self-bastes the lean meat (2 sources)
start breast-down 20 min then flip breast-up for juicy breast plus crisp skin (1 source)
doneness = clear thigh juices (3 sources) or 77C between leg and thigh (2 sources)
hotter oven 200-220C for 60-70 min (3 sources) vs slower 175-190C for 95-120 min (2 sources)
gravy = pan juices browned with 1 tbsp plain flour + 375 ml stock (1 source); cornflour slurry swap keeps it gluten free
adding water/stock to the tray mid-roast stops veg sticking and makes pan juices (2 sources)
pumpkin and sweet potato in large chunks go in at the start, same rate as chicken (variation notes, 2 AU sources)
